development_corpus.note: engineering comparison set, not a sealed bank

interpretation: dedicated supervised belief training produced the dominant gain (unchanged Phase 11 head 0.9834 -> same 1,548 parameters retrained 0.9531)
enlarging the head helped only modestly (1A 0.9531 -> 1B MLP 0.9495)
allowing the final C1 block to adapt produced the best result (1C 0.9460)
raw-observation and C1-feature CNNs were worse despite being larger (A2 0.9686, A3 0.9624, A4 hybrid 0.9614, each 3.9M parameters vs 1B's 334,860)
C1's representation appears highly useful and sample-efficient at the current data scale (same tower on C1 features beats raw pixels; adding raw pixels to C1 adds nothing measurable)
